svg.title: ttt-one-step
svg.desc: Toy, d = 3, beta = 1: S_{t-1} stores e1 to e1 and e2 to e2; the new pair is k = e1, v = e3. Linear attention takes the gradient of minus <Sk, v>, adds v k^T and reads back [1, 0, 1]: the old value survives, error 1. DeltaNet takes the gradient of 1/2 ||Sk - v||^2, subtracts (Sk - v) k^T and reads back exactly [0, 0, 1], error 0. Decay alpha_t before the step acts as weight decay.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: St = αt St-1 − βt ∇ℓt (αt St-1 ) read ot = St qt
